## Employee Benefits Guide 2026

Human Resources

## 1. Health

All employees are covered by private occupational health care from day one, including dental check-ups once a year.

Eyeglasses for screen work are reimbursed up to EUR 250 every two years.

## 2. Wellbeing

The annual wellbeing allowance is EUR 400, usable for sports, culture and massage.

Employees may take one paid volunteering day per year.

## 3. Pension and insurance

The company contributes 4% of base salary to the voluntary pension plan when the employee contributes at least 2%.

Travel insurance covers all business trips and the employee's spouse when travelling together.

## 4. Bike and commuting

The bike benefit allows leasing a bike of up to EUR 3,000 through salary deduction.

Public transport tickets are subsidised by 50% up to EUR 60 per month.
